prompt:
You are a professional Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and document digitization engine.
Transcribe ALL text, tables, columns, rows, handwritten marks and headers found in this image into structured JSON.

Rules:
- Read ONLY what is actually written or printed in this image. Never invent, assume or substitute data from any other document. Keep the original language, spelling and numerals.
- If a cell is blank, return an empty string. If it is unreadable, return your best reading and lower its confidence.
- Keep every row in the order it appears. Do not merge or skip rows.
- For handwriting that is faint, smudged or ambiguous, give 2-3 candidate readings with probabilities that sum to about 1.
- cellConfidence is 0..1 per column key: 0.95+ for clear print, 0.85-0.95 for clear handwriting, below 0.85 when you are unsure.

Return STRICT JSON matching this shape (no markdown, no commentary):
{
  "documentType": "forestry_inventory" | "tabular_form" | "school_bulletin" | "general_document",
  "title": "Exact title as written on the document",
  "institution": "Issuing organisation, school, business or ministry in the header",
  "subHeader": "Secondary subtitle, location or branch if present",
  "personName": "Person, candidate or employee name if present",
  "idNumber": "Registration, plot or reference number if present",
  "summary": "One sentence describing the document",
  "metadataFields": [ { "label": "Header field name", "value": "Header field value" } ],
  "tableHeaders": [ { "key": "col_1", "label": "First column name as written" } ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "rowNumber": 1,
      "cells": { "col_1": "value", "col_2": "value" },
      "cellConfidence": { "col_1": 0.97, "col_2": 0.72 },
      "candidateValues": {
        "col_2": [
          { "value": "Most likely reading", "probability": 0.7, "reason": "short reason" },
          { "value": "Alternative reading", "probability": 0.3, "reason": "short reason" }
        ]
      },
      "comments": []
    }
  ]
}
